shell.suspended: Your account is suspended. You can still read, but cannot create, join or message.

errors.somethingWrongBody: SmartSync hit an unexpected error on this screen. Your account, activities and messages are stored on the server and are not affected.
errors.staleBody: SmartSync has been updated since this tab was opened, or the connection dropped while loading. Reload to get the latest version — nothing on your account is affected.
errors.routeBody: Something went wrong here. The rest of SmartSync is still working — use the tabs below to go somewhere else, or try this screen again.
errors.profileBody: You are signed in, but your profile could not be loaded. This is usually a connection problem.
errors.pageNotFoundBody: That page does not exist. Everything else is still running normally.

closed.title: This account has been closed
closed.body: SmartSync closed this account for breaking the community policy. It can no longer host, join, or message anybody.
closed.why: SmartSync exists to get people into the same room safely. An account is only closed when keeping it open would work against that.

splash.headline: Meet people by doing things.
splash.lead: Activities happening near you in Bangkok — and who is going to them.
splash.step1Body: Football, coffee, study, gaming — whatever you would actually turn up for.
splash.step2Title: See what is on near you
splash.step2Body: Real activities with real times and places, as a list or on a map.
splash.step3Body: One tap to join, then chat with everyone going before you turn up.
splash.trust: Free to use. Block or report anyone, and a moderator reviews every report. You can share your location rounded to the nearest kilometre — or not at all.

signIn.lead: Sign in to see what is happening near you.
signIn.enterEmailFirst: Enter your email first, then tap reset.
signIn.resetSent: If that email has an account, a reset link is on its way.

signUp.title: Create your account

signOutDialog.title: Sign out?

signOutDialog.settingsBody: You will need your email and password to sign back in. Nothing is deleted.

create.title: Start an activity
create.lead: Everyone using SmartSync will be able to find and join it.

privacy.title: Privacy controls
privacy.lead: These settings change what other people can actually read about you, not just what this app chooses to display.
privacy.anonymousHint: Your real name is removed from the profile others can read
privacy.locationHint: Used to sort activities by distance
privacy.approximateHint: Round your position to about a kilometre before storing it
privacy.howBody: Your email, your real name while anonymous mode is on, and your stored position live in a part of your profile the database will not serve to anyone but you. Activity chats are readable only by people who joined that activity, and close 30 days after it — after that nobody can open the thread, including us.

blocked.title: Blocked people
blocked.lead: You do not see their activities and they cannot join yours. They are not told that you blocked them.
blocked.nobodyBody: You can block someone from a participant list, the people screen, or when reporting them.
blocked.dialogBody: You will start seeing their activities again, and they will be able to join yours.

warnings.title: Warnings
warnings.lead: SmartSync exists to get people into the same room safely. A warning means something you did worked against that, and that it was noticed — nothing has been taken away.
warnings.loadFailedBody: Check your connection and try again.
warnings.nothingBody: You have not been warned about anything.

weights.title: Signal weights
weights.lead: Every activity is scored out of 100 against these six signals. Move a slider and the ranking below reorders immediately.
weights.allZero: Every signal is at zero, so nothing can be ranked. Raise at least one.
weights.previewEmpty: No upcoming activities to rank yet.
weights.note: These weights are stored on this device only and change what you see, not what anyone else sees. EVALUATION.md in the repository measures what each signal is worth.

picks.title: Made for you
picks.lead: Only {{interests}} — the interests you chose. Ranked by how well each one fits, not by when it happens.
picks.noInterestsTitle: Tell it what you like first
picks.noInterestsBody: This page only ever shows the categories you choose. Pick a few and it fills up straight away.
picks.nothingBody: Nobody is hosting {{interests}} at the moment. Discover has everything that is on, or you can add an interest.
picks.howLead: Each match score is split between six signals.
picks.nothingIn: Nothing in {{interests}} right now. It will appear here as soon as somebody hosts one.
picks.peopleForYouHint: Find similar people and follow their activities

pickDetails.lead: How well this matches your profile.
pickDetails.note: Every activity is scored against these six signals.

matching.title: People for you
matching.lead: Follow people whose activities you want to hear about.
matching.noneBody: When other people join SmartSync they will show up here, ranked by how well you match.
matching.alertedWhen: You'll be alerted when {{name}} posts an activity.
matching.getAlerted: Get alerted when {{name}} posts an activity.

moderation.lead: Every action records who took it and why. Nothing here can be deleted.
moderation.capped: Showing the newest {{count}} open reports. Older ones are not listed, and the “reported N×” counts below only count what is shown. Work the queue down to see them.
moderation.nothingWaitingBody: Reports appear here as soon as someone files one.
moderation.onHoldLead: They can still read SmartSync. They cannot create, join or message, and nothing they host accepts new people.
moderation.moderatorOnlyAdmin: A moderator. Only an admin can lift this suspension.
moderation.everyoneHint: Look without waiting to be told
moderation.moderatorsHint: Who holds the rank, and appointing

toasts.whoIsThisAbout: Couldn't tell who this is about

toasts.partlyStoodDown: Suspended, but not everything came down
toasts.standDownSummary: {{stoodDown}} {{noun}} stood down, but {{failed}} could not be — open their profile and suspend again to retry.
toasts.recordedWithStandDown: Recorded against the report. {{count}} {{noun}} they were hosting stood down, and everyone who joined has been told.
toasts.recorded: The decision is recorded against the report.
toasts.putBackBody: {{title}} is visible again, and the host has been told.
toasts.adminOnlyRestore: Only an admin can undo a removal.
toasts.liftedBody: {{name}} can post again, and has been told. Anything taken down while they were suspended stays down.
toasts.liftedBodyShort: {{name}} can post again, and has been told. Anything taken down stays down.
toasts.adminOnlyModerator: Only an admin can act on a moderator.
toasts.adminOnlyModeratorAdmin: Only an admin can act on a moderator, and nobody can act on an admin.
toasts.cannotActStoodDown: {{name}} cannot create, join or message. {{count}} {{noun}} stood down, and everyone who joined has been told.
toasts.adminDecision: Closing and reopening an account is an admin decision, and no rank can act on an admin.
toasts.warningIssuedBody: {{name}} has been told, and it is on their record. Nothing was taken away.
toasts.partlyClosed: Closed, but not everything came down
toasts.closedBodyStoodDown: {{name}} can no longer use SmartSync. {{count}} {{noun}} stood down, and everyone who joined has been told.
toasts.reopenedBody: {{name}} can use SmartSync again, and has been told.
toasts.appointedBody: {{name}} can work this queue now, and has been told.
toasts.dismissedBody: {{name}} can no longer review reports. Their account is otherwise unchanged.
toasts.adminOnlyAppoint: Only an admin can appoint or dismiss a moderator.

dialogs.removeBody: It disappears for everyone, including the people who joined, and they are all told. The host cannot undo this — only an admin can.
dialogs.suspendBody: {{name}} can still sign in and read, but cannot create activities, join anything, or send messages. Anything they are hosting is taken down and everyone who joined is told — lifting the suspension later does not bring those back.
dialogs.dismissBody: The report stays on record, marked as needing no action.
dialogs.appointBody: {{name}} will be able to read every report, take activities down and suspend ordinary users. They cannot appoint anybody, undo a takedown, or act on a report about themselves.
dialogs.appointBodySuspended: Their account is suspended, so they will hold the rank and use none of it until that is lifted.
dialogs.dismissModeratorBody: {{name}} loses access to this queue. Nothing else about their account changes — a suspension, if they have one, stays exactly as it is.
dialogs.liftBody: {{name}} can create, join and message again, and will be told. Anything taken down while they were suspended stays down.
dialogs.warnBody: {{name}} is told what the problem is and it goes on their record. Nothing is taken away — this is the step before anything is.
dialogs.closeBody: {{name}} will not be able to use SmartSync again. Everything they are hosting is taken down and everyone who joined is told. Only an admin can reverse this.
dialogs.reopenBody: {{name}} can use SmartSync again. Anything taken down while the account was closed stays down.
dialogs.warnPrompt: What are you warning them about?
dialogs.closePrompt: Why is this account being closed?
dialogs.warnPlaceholder: Several people reported the same behaviour
dialogs.closePlaceholder: Repeated safety reports after a warning
dialogs.reopenPlaceholder: Reviewed again — the closure was mistaken

removedPage.title: Removed activities
removedPage.lead: Everything moderators have taken down. Putting one back is recorded against it, and the host is told.
removedPage.whyPutBack: Why are you putting this back?
removedPage.nothingBody: Activities removed by a moderator will be listed here.

people.title: Everyone on SmartSync
people.lead: . Anyone suspended, or with something taken down, is listed first. You are seeing public profiles — emails, real names behind anonymous mode and stored locations are not readable by anybody but their owner.
people.windowNote: The first {{count}} accounts are loaded. Anyone else can still be found by searching — the search also asks the server.
people.searchFailed: The server could not be searched just now — only the accounts already loaded are shown.
people.foundBySearch: found by search — activity counts not loaded
people.isAdmin: An admin. No rank can act on this account from inside the app.
people.isModerator: A moderator. Only an admin can act on this account.
people.nobodyBody: Try part of a name, or clear the search to see everyone.
people.showingFirst: Showing the first {{shown}} of {{count}}. Search to narrow it down.

moderatorsPage.title: Moderators
moderatorsPage.lead: Who can work this queue. From the moment they are appointed they can take activities down and suspend ordinary users, and they are told so.
moderatorsPage.suspendedNote: Suspended, so they hold the rank and use none of it. Lift it above to give the powers back.
moderatorsPage.noneBody: Every report is yours alone until you appoint somebody.
moderatorsPage.typeToFind: Type a name to find somebody. Current moderators and admins are not listed here.
moderatorsPage.noneMatch: Nobody else matches “{{query}}”. Anyone already holding a rank is left out of this list.
moderatorsPage.adminNote: That rank is granted in the Firebase console and nowhere else — there is no button for it here, on purpose.
